answer_1.quote: four fundamental one-step tasks are crucial for screen stream understanding... Screen Summarization: This task involves summarizing the main contents or functions of the screen with several sentences.
answer_1.outputs: Screen summaries, action commands, question answers

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics... accuracy computed at IoU=0.5 for UI grounding, SQuAD-F1 score for screen question answering, and CIDEr for UI referring.

answer_3.quote: For Chinese screen summarizations... we employ GPT-4O as the judger to score the responses from four different perspectives.

answer_4.quote: We recruit around 50 annotators... our data quality team conducts acceptance checks... 10% of the images are sampled for inspection.
answer_4.guideline: Verify model-generated answers and correct errors per image
